
{{alias}}( σ )
    Returns the skewness of a half-normal distribution with scale paramter `σ`.

    If provided `NaN` as any argument, the function returns `NaN`.

    If provided `σ <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    σ: number
        Scale parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: number
        Skewness.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 1.0 )
    0.995
    > y = {{alias}}( 3.0 )
    0.995
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.0 )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
